does the contention model say anything about which session should eat the 429?
Six sessions on one account behave like six independent greedy clients. Nothing in the system knows the other five exist.
The session that eats the 529 is whichever happened to be mid-request, which is uncorrelated with what you care about — the foreground one is as likely to stall as a background documentation sweep.
